maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from employer recruiting subscriptions and job postings on Dice and ClearanceJobs, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paying customers are private employers and recruiters, including defense contractors like Lockheed Martin, buying job postings and candidate database access.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth mainly comes from selling Dice and ClearanceJobs subscriptions; M&A is mentioned but acquisitions are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Recruiters can use competing job boards or LinkedIn and switch easily; subscriptions are short-term and not deeply embedded.
